title: B. The Meeting Place Cannot Be Changed

legend: The main road in Bytecity is a straight line from south to north. Conveniently, there are coordinates measured in meters from the southernmost building in north direction.

At some points on the road there are n friends, and i-th of them is standing at the point xi meters and can move with any speed no greater than vi meters per second in any of the two directions along the road: south or north.
You are to compute the minimum time needed to gather all the n friends at some point on the road. Note that the point they meet at doesn't need to have integer coordinate.
input: The first line contains single integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 60 000) — the number of friends.
The second line contains n integers x1, x2, ..., xn (1 ≤ xi ≤ 109) — the current coordinates of the friends, in meters.
The third line contains n integers v1, v2, ..., vn (1 ≤ vi ≤ 109) — the maximum speeds of the friends, in meters per second.
output: Print the minimum time (in seconds) needed for all the n friends to meet at some point on the road.

Your answer will be considered correct, if its absolute or relative error isn't greater than 10 - 6. Formally, let your answer be a, while jury's answer be b. Your answer will be considered correct if ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/354edc27fee211170922d7a154f57d15b2eb8afb.png) holds.
note: In the first sample, all friends can gather at the point 5 within 2 seconds. In order to achieve this, the first friend should go south all the time at his maximum speed, while the second and the third friends should go north at their maximum speeds.

legend.ai: Bytecity 的主干道是一条由南向北的直线。方便的是，这里的坐标以最南端的建筑为起点，沿北方向以米为单位测量。
道路上的某些位置有 n 个朋友，其中第 i 个朋友站在距离某处 xi 米的位置，并且可以沿道路向南或向北移动，速度不超过每秒 vi 米。
你需要计算让所有 n 位朋友在道路上的某个位置集合所需的最短时间。注意，他们集合的位置不一定具有整数坐标。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，所有朋友都可以在 2 秒内聚集到点 5。为此，第一个朋友应始终以最大速度向南移动，而第二个和第三个朋友应以最大速度向北移动。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（2 ≤ n ≤ 60 000），表示朋友的数量。
第二行包含 n 个整数 x1, x2, ..., xn（1 ≤ xi ≤ 109），表示朋友当前所在的坐标，单位为米。
第三行包含 n 个整数 v1, v2, ..., vn（1 ≤ vi ≤ 109），表示朋友的最大速度，单位为米每秒。

output.ai: 输出让所有 n 位朋友在道路上的某个位置集合所需的最短时间，单位为秒。
如果你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 10 - 6，则认为答案正确。形式化地，设你的答案为 a，而评测器的答案为 b。当 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/354edc27fee211170922d7a154f57d15b2eb8afb.png) 成立时，你的答案将被认为是正确的。
